description: Compact the conversation when the context passes a fixed window, instead of the window Claude Code picks for the model.
source: Claude Code settings documentation (autoCompactWindow: any settings file, 100000 to 1000000 tokens, capped at the model's context window; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW takes precedence; modelSettings can override per model), read 2026-11-12. Hive plan section 4.
